{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 391,
      "where": "Proof of 6.2, identification of the localized sites",
      "scan": "$U_{\\text{ét}}$ est canoniquement isomorphe",
      "tex": "$U_{\\text{ét}}$ es canoniquement isomorphe",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$U_{\\text{ét}}$ es",
        "new": "$U_{\\text{ét}}$ est"
      },
      "note": "The final t of « est » is missing in the TeX."
    },
    {
      "page": 391,
      "where": "Theorem 6.3, characterization of the essential image",
      "scan": "de le forme",
      "tex": "de la forme",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "de la forme",
      "note": "The print has « de le forme »; the TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 392,
      "where": "Proof of 6.3, converse: both displays and the intervening and concluding references to G",
      "scan": "$G \\to i_{\\ast}i^{\\ast}G$; « l'hypothèse faite sur G »; $i^{\\ast}(G) \\to i^{\\ast}(i_{\\ast}i^{\\ast}(G))$; « appliqué à F = i^{\\ast}G »",
      "tex": "$G \\to i_{\\ast} i^{\\ast} G$; « l'hypothèse faite sur $G$ »; $i^{\\ast} (G) \\to i^{\\ast} (i_{\\ast} i^{\\ast} (G))$; « appliqué à $F = i^{\\ast} G$ »",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$F \\to i_{\\ast}i^{\\ast}F$; l'hypothèse faite sur $F$; $i^{\\ast}(F) \\to i^{\\ast}(i_{\\ast}i^{\\ast}(F))$; 5.7 appliqué au faisceau $i^{\\ast}F$ et à $i$",
      "note": "The converse introduces F on X but then mistakenly calls it G. The TeX retains this notational slip throughout the two displays, the hypothesis, and the final application of 5.7."
    },
    {
      "page": 393,
      "where": "6.5, opening reference to the residual topos",
      "scan": "$ℰ_{\\complement U}$",
      "tex": "$ℰ_\\complement U$",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$ℰ_\\complement U$",
        "new": "$ℰ_{\\complement U}$"
      },
      "note": "Both the complement sign and U belong to the subscript in the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 393,
      "where": "6.5, description by triples",
      "scan": "en terme des triplets",
      "tex": "en terme\ndes triplets",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "en termes des triplets",
      "note": "The expression requires the plural « termes ». The TeX keeps the printed singular."
    },
    {
      "page": 393,
      "where": "6.5, target of the gluing homomorphism u",
      "scan": "$i^{\\ast}j_{\\ast}(F')$",
      "tex": "$i^{\\ast}\nj_{\\ast} (F')$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "i^{\\ast}j_{\\ast}(F'')",
      "note": "The argument of j_* must be F'', the sheaf on U, rather than F', the sheaf on Y. The TeX retains the printed single prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 393,
      "where": "6.6, first sentence",
      "scan": "qui précédent",
      "tex": "qui précédent",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "qui précèdent",
      "note": "The verb requires « précèdent », with a grave accent on the second e. The TeX keeps the printed spelling."
    },
    {
      "page": 393,
      "where": "6.6, identification of the local cohomology functor",
      "scan": "$ℋ^{q}_Y = R^q i^{!}$",
      "tex": "$ℋ^{q}_Y  = R^{q_{y}!}$",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "R^{q_{y}!}",
        "new": "R^q i^{!}"
      },
      "note": "The print gives the q-th derived functor of i!, not an exponent containing q with subscript y."
    },
    {
      "page": 394,
      "where": "7.1, first sentence",
      "scan": "un X-schéma strictement local",
      "tex": "un $x$-schéma strictement local",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$x$-schéma",
        "new": "$X$-schéma"
      },
      "note": "The base scheme is capital X in the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 394,
      "where": "7.1, equivalence of categories",
      "scan": "avec la catégorie des",
      "tex": "avec la catégories des",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "avec la catégories des",
        "new": "avec la catégorie des"
      },
      "note": "The print has the singular « catégorie »."
    },
    {
      "page": 394,
      "where": "7.1, paragraph beginning « Ce dernier énoncé »",
      "scan": "la seconde catégorie",
      "tex": "la seconds catégorie",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "la seconds catégorie",
        "new": "la seconde catégorie"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « seconde », not « seconds »."
    },
    {
      "page": 394,
      "where": "Definition 7.2, opening sentence",
      "scan": "on appelle flèche de spécialisation",
      "tex": "on a\nappelle flèche de spécialisation",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "on a\nappelle",
        "new": "on\nappelle"
      },
      "note": "The TeX adds an a between « on » and « appelle »."
    },
    {
      "page": 395,
      "where": "Lemma 7.3(b)",
      "scan": "l'image x'",
      "tex": "l'images $x'$",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "l'images $x'$",
        "new": "l'image $x'$"
      },
      "note": "The print has the singular « image »."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "391: 1/1; 392: 0/1; 393: 2/3; 394: 4/0; 395: 1/0 (normal/misprint)."
}
